name: @scenity/rules
author: Leonardo Amoroso Custodio
description: The metric library of Scenity: the built-in metrics (distance, overlap, belowFloor, ikError, jointAngle, reach, visible, walkway, routeClear, triangleBudget, assetRights), the registry of plugin metrics and the metric context over the facts of a scene at a time. It also holds the seeded layout search over op paths (searchLayout). Pure TypeScript: no three.js, no DOM, no Vue. The editor, the CLI and the tools of Claude read it.
